user.title: Phicomm R1
user.description: IP of the speaker and its WebSocket port. Press Submit to check.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the speaker (no connection or unexpected reply).

init.title: R1 speaker settings
init.description: Speaker address and control/EQ port; microphone stream (raw PCM 16 kHz mono 16-bit over TCP, empty mic host disables listening); intercom playback channel to the speaker (port 0 = none; the speaker side does NOT exist yet); the four voice-gate parameters of the intercom (defaults NOT yet measured on the speaker). Wake word: 'ha' = HA detects it (mic streams to HA continuously); 'speaker' = detected ON the speaker, HA receives audio only after the trigger (the speaker side does NOT exist yet).

data.talk_tail_s: Wait after playback before reopening the mic (s)
data.rotate_intercom_key: Rotate the intercom URL key (old go2rtc lines stop working)
data.noise_strength_db: Noise suppression: max reduction per band (dB)
data.noise_voice_db: Noise suppression: voice threshold (dB above floor)
data.agc_silence_db: AGC: below this level counts as silence, no boost (dBFS)
data.limiter_ceiling: Limiter: ceiling (fraction of full scale, 0.89 ≈ -1 dBFS)
data.ha_url: Home Assistant address the speaker calls (empty = guess)
data.mic_listen_port: Microphone listen port (speaker APK connects to HA)
data.mic_listen_key: Microphone listen key (empty = listen port closed)
data.duplex_preroll_s: Duplex call: audio kept before speech (s)
data.duplex_hangover_s: Duplex call: audio kept after speech (s)
data.duplex_duck: Duplex call: drop quiet mic audio while HA is playing (echo cut, off by default)
data.wake_enable: Wake word (device side, not active yet)

error.invalid_ha_url: Address must look like http(s)://host[:port] with no path, spaces or #.
error.ha_url_loopback: 127.0.0.1 / localhost points back at the speaker or go2rtc, not at Home Assistant. Use the LAN address of the machine that runs HA.
error.ha_url_unreachable: Home Assistant could not reach this address (or it is not this Home Assistant). Nothing was saved.

get_intercom_source.name: Get intercom source
get_intercom_source.description: Returns two go2rtc.yaml source lines: talk to the speaker (talk) and listen to its microphone (listen).

ha_url.name: HA URL
ha_url.description: HA address reachable from the go2rtc host; leave empty when go2rtc shares HA's network.

get_wake_endpoint.name: Get wake endpoint
get_wake_endpoint.description: Returns the URL the wake-word service ON the speaker will POST to (speaker side NOT built yet).

ha_url.name: HA URL
ha_url.description: HA address reachable from the go2rtc host; leave empty when go2rtc shares HA's network.

set_light_function.name: Set light for a function
set_light_function.description: Changes the LED settings of one function (on/off, rim light, base colour, effect, brightness). The rim light is white only. Stored in HA; nothing is sent to the speaker until a light service exists on the speaker (NOT built yet).

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: Any r1_speaker entity of the speaker.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Off = no light while this function is active.

rim.name: Rim light (white)
rim.description: Use the white rim light at the same brightness.

color.name: Base colour
color.description: #rrggbb of the base light. Only green and blue are confirmed on the hardware; red is unconfirmed.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Effect from the catalogue, or none for a steady colour.

set_music_light.name: Set music light
set_music_light.description: Light effect while music plays (the 'Music playing (HA effect)' function, NOT the speaker firmware's music light — see the Music light entities): on/off, effect, brightness. The speaker firmware's own music light is controlled by the Music light entities.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: Any r1_speaker entity of the speaker.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Off = no HA light effect for music.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Effect from the catalogue, or none.

preview_light.name: Preview light
preview_light.description: Shows one function's light for a few seconds, then returns to the real state. Needs a light service on the speaker.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: Any r1_speaker entity of the speaker.
